        self.age = age
        self.status = 0  # Initialize status to 0

def allocate_memory(size):
    # Simulate memory allocation by creating a list of size 'size'
    # In real scenarios, this would be handled by the operating system or a memory manager
    memory_block = [None] * size
    return memory_block

def allocate_person():
    # Allocate memory for a person (assuming one unit of memory per person)
    memory_block = allocate_memory(1)
    # Create a new Person object and assign it to the first position
    person = Person("Unknown", 0)
    memory_block[0] = person
    # Return a pointer (index) to the allocated person
    return memory_block, 0

# Example usage
memory, pointer = allocate_person()
print(f"Person allocated at memory index {pointer}")
print(f"Person status: {memory[pointer].status}")

import ctypes

class Person(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [("status", ctypes.c_int)]

# Função para alocar memória para uma pessoa
def allocate_person():
    person_ptr = ctypes.cast(ctypes.c_void_p(ctypes.pythonapi.PyMem_Malloc(ctypes.sizeof(Person))), ctypes.POINTER(Person))
    return person_ptr

# Função para liberar memória alocada
def free_person(person_ptr):
    ctypes.pythonapi.PyMem_Free(ctypes.cast(person_ptr, ctypes.c_void_p))

# Alocar uma nova pessoa
person = allocate_person()

# Definir o campo de status como 0
person.contents.status = 0

# Imprimir o valor do campo de status
print(person.contents.status)

# Liberar a memória alocada
free_person(person)

import ctypes

# サイズを定義
class Person(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [
        ("name", ctypes.c_char_p),
        ("status", ctypes.c_int)
    ]

# メモリ割り当て関数
def allocate_person():
    person_ptr = ctypes.POINTER(Person)()
    person_ptr = ctypes.cast(ctypes.malloc(ctypes.sizeof(Person)), ctypes.POINTER(Person))
    if person_ptr:
        person_ptr.contents.status = 0
    return person_ptr

# メモリ解放関数
def free_person(person_ptr):
    if person_ptr:
        ctypes.free(person_ptr)

# テストコード
def test_allocate_person():
    # 担当者を割り当て
    person_ptr = allocate_person()
    assert person_ptr is not None, "メモリ割り当てに失敗しました"
    
    # 名前を設定
    person_ptr.contents.name = ctypes.c_char_p(b"Alice")
    
    # 名前が "Alice" であることを確認
    assert person_ptr.contents.name.decode('utf-8') == "Alice", "名前がAliceではありません"
    
    # メモリを解放
    free_person(person_ptr)

# テスト実行
test_allocate_person()

import ctypes

class Person:
    def __init__(self):
        self.name = ""
        self.age = 0
        self.status = 0  # Durum alanı

# Bellek ayırma yöntemi
def allocate_person():
    # sizeof(person) boyutunda bir bellek bloğu ayır
    person_ptr = ctypes.POINTER(Person)()
    person_ptr = ctypes.cast(ctypes.malloc(ctypes.sizeof(Person)), ctypes.POINTER(Person))
    
    # Durum alanını 0 olarak ayarla
    person_ptr.contents.status = 0
    
    return person_ptr

# Ana program
if __name__ == "__main__":
    # Yeni bir kişiyi tahsis et
    person = allocate_person()
    
    # Kişiyi ekrana yazdır
    print(f"İsim: {person.contents.name}")
    print(f"Yaş: {person.contents.age}")
    print(f"Durum: {person.contents.status}")
    
    # Belleği serbest bırak
    ctypes.free(person)
